title: hepetis morelii
intro: Hepetis morelii, commonly known as Mexican tea, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to Mexico and Central America. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Hepetis morelii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties. The plant's bioactive constituents also contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues.
